title: OrgsInviteConfig
description: Authoring-time configuration for one invitation. `email` is the chain-parameter position (`{{params.newHireEmail}}`, RFC 0013 Path A — frozen per instance); `role` and `orgId` are optional. Runtime inputs win on conflict (the merged-args idiom). Authorization is never configured here: it is the run's acting user holding host:members:manage in the target org (the SAME predicate the /orgs/:orgId/invites routes use), checked in the host surface.

email.description: Recipient address (fallback when no edge delivers `inputs.email`). Normalised lower-case at mint; must be email-shaped or the node fails typed (`invalid_email`).

role.description: The accessControl role the invite grants. Never `owner` — ownership is granted explicitly through accessControl.

orgId.description: Target org. Empty ⇒ the run's workspace root (`orgId === tenantId`). A foreign or unknown org is a uniform not_found.
